objects.name: bloom_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 只校验Bloom产品node的required inputs/produced outputs，不实际bloom录制；实际提取由bloom_extract_executor。

objects.name: color_lut_bake_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: GPU帧图无ColorLutBake node直接Ok；有节点录制COLOR_LUT且传真实executor ID供compute诊断。

objects.name: taa_resolve_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 仅frame TAA开启；获取TAA output/current history写ops默认clear_store，按声明route选scene input，记录depth/velocity/previous history/reactive/output/current合约。

objects.name: taa_reactive_mask_mesh_executor
objects.semantic: TAA开时mesh写reactive mask并用SCENE_DEPTH；关闭不编码。

objects.name: output_transfer_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 从本pass声明读route选最后upscale/AA/tonemap，目标FINAL_COLOR，目标write ops默认clear_store再GPU输出转换。

objects.name: primary_upscale_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 传PrimaryUpscale effect/PRIMARY_UPSCALED/PrimarySpatialUpscale phase给共享helper。

objects.name: secondary_upscale_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 传SecondaryUpscale effect/SECONDARY_UPSCALED/SecondarySpatialUpscale，允许输入primary结果。

objects.name: spatial_upscale_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 先产品node资源验证，再取目标写ops和声明input route，最后按phase录制upscale；产品node缺省Ok不代替后续GPU资源校验。

objects.name: fxaa_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 先Fxaa node契约验证，target FINAL_COMPOSITED按声明ops写，input优先TONEMAPPED。

objects.name: smaa_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 对应Smaa node验证和同terminal AA target，专用record_smaa路径；不调用FXAA实现。

objects.name: motion_blur_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: MotionBlur node验证后MOTION_BLURRED write ops/default clear送专用GPU效果；frame gate由graph安排和GPU效果判断。

objects.name: blur_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: Blur验证后写BLURRED，read input由专用GPU effects解析而非此入口硬猜。

objects.name: depth_of_field_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: DepthOfField验证后写DEPTH_OF_FIELDED按附件契约，准备资源由prepare入口。

objects.name: scene_composite_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: SceneComposite验证后写SCENE_COMPOSITED按当前passops。

objects.name: exposure_histogram_executor
objects.semantic: 仅Histogram exposure mode记录SCENE_COLOR->EXPOSURE_HISTOGRAM，否则Ok；读取mode仍require GPU。

objects.name: exposure_resolve_executor
objects.semantic: histogram/previous/current exposure资源带executorID交compute resolve，具体mode由GPU专用record决定。

objects.name: clustered_lighting_executor
objects.semantic: LIGHT_GRID_PARAMS/ZBINS/TILE_MASKS/LIGHT_LIST按规范名和ID交GPU工作，不创建独立queue提交。

objects.name: hzb_build_executor
objects.semantic: SCENE_DEPTH生成HZB_FURTHEST，GPU逐mip实现child/context另核。

objects.name: hzb_occlusion_cull_executor
objects.semantic: 历史previous furthest HZB供occlusion indirect args，传ID为诊断/计划关联。

objects.name: bloom_extract_executor
objects.semantic: 按声明route选择motionblur/TAA/DoF/scene input，生成BLOOM；区别只验证node的post.bloom。

objects.name: velocity_camera_executor
objects.semantic: TAA/motionblur/SSR任一需velocity才编码；depth->scene velocity camera contribution固定load_store保留已有贡献。

objects.name: velocity_mesh_object_executor
objects.semantic: 同scene velocity gate；使用velocity当前pass write ops默认load_store，scene depth约束object贡献。

objects.name: particle_velocity_executor
objects.semantic: 同velocity gate及附件ops，专用particle velocity recording。

objects.name: motion_vector_tile_max_executor
objects.semantic: motionblur/SSR需重建vectors时SCENE_VELOCITY->MOTION_VECTOR_TILE_MAX clear_store。

objects.name: motion_vector_tile_max_coarse_executor
objects.semantic: 同gate，fine tile->coarse tile clear_store。

objects.name: motion_vector_neighbor_max_executor
objects.semantic: 同gate，coarse tile->neighbor max clear_store供motionblur/SSR。

objects.name: depth_of_field_prepare_executor
objects.semantic: DoF开时SCENE_COLOR/DEPTH生成COC/BOKEH，未开不编码。

objects.name: screen_space_reflection_resolve_executor
objects.semantic: SSR开启后history写ops及scene color/depth、neighbor vectors、HZB、两级pyramid、specular occlusion全部传专用SSR resolve。

objects.name: screen_space_reflection_reflection_pyramid_executor
objects.semantic: SSR开时scene color->fine reflection pyramid，用当前写ops/defaultclear。

objects.name: screen_space_reflection_reflection_pyramid_coarse_executor
objects.semantic: SSR开时fine->coarse pyramid，后续resolve声明两者。

objects.name: screen_space_reflection_specular_occlusion_executor
objects.semantic: SSR开时scene depth->specular occlusion，写ops/defaultclear。

objects.name: uber_postprocess_executor
objects.semantic: 只传pass label录制已准备postprocess stack，不调用未消费的uber_input_resource route（其函数cfg(test)）。

objects.name: borrowed_gpu_metadata_restores_context_when_gpu_is_missing
objects.semantic: 无GPUhelper返Err仍断言原pass_name/executorID，直接覆盖普通错误路径恢复，不覆盖panic。
